title: Vaginal microbiota are associated with in vitro fertilization during female infertility
data_scale: 1,411 women (1,255 embryo transfers), 16S; 71 metagenomes
main_methods: 16S community-state typing; outcome association; metagenomics subset
headline_claim: Moderate (~80%), not maximal, Lactobacillus abundance associates with best IVF pregnancy rates
what_made_it_strong: Large clinical n; counter-intuitive, actionable message

title: The rheumatoid arthritis gut microbial biobank reveals core microbial species that associate and effect on host inflammation and autoimmune responses
data_scale: 3,200 isolates from 20 RA patients -> 601 strains, 280 species (43 novel)
main_methods: Culturomics; phylogenetics; correlation with clinical indices; validation
headline_claim: First RA gut microbial biobank; 20-species core microbiome linked to inflammation
what_made_it_strong: Tangible resource others can use

title: Unraveling interindividual variation of trimethylamine N‐oxide and its precursors at the population level
data_scale: 7,834 individuals, 5 Dutch prospective cohorts
main_methods: Cox models (HR, 95% CI); GWAS; microbiome association; diet; Mendelian randomization
headline_claim: Choline, not TMAO, associates with CVD risk; 10 loci and 68 microbiome associations for TMAO pathway
what_made_it_strong: Population-scale multi-cohort design; challenges a popular biomarker; CIs reported

title: A universal oral microbiome‐based signature for periodontitis
data_scale: 8 public oral shotgun cohorts, 5 countries, 3 continents; 117 cases/106 controls for modelling + 118 case-only validation samples
main_methods: Per-cohort differential abundance; cross-cohort consistent markers (>=3 cohorts); random forest with repeated 5-fold CV; cohort-to-cohort transfer matrix; leave-one-dataset-out (LODO); sample-cumulation sample-size modelling; co-abundance network; function-based classifiers
headline_claim: Species-level oral signature (54 species) generalises across cohorts; LODO raises mean external AUC 0.79->0.85
what_made_it_strong: Cross-cohort transfer heatmap (train x test AUC) + LODO; world/flowchart panel; honest negative result (function-based classifiers weak); minimal-sample-size estimate

title: Non‐differential gut microbes contribute to hypertension and its severity through co‐abundances: A multi‐regional prospective cohort study
data_scale: GGMP: 2,355 hypertensive + 4,644 non-hypertensive, 14 regions (Guangdong)
main_methods: Per-region CCLasso co-abundance networks; random-effects meta-analysis across 14 regions; heterogeneity testing; replication; comorbidity sensitivity; FDR
tool_or_resource_released: No tool; data in ENA PRJEB18535
headline_claim: Non-differential microbes drive hypertension-related co-abundances that scale with severity
what_made_it_strong: Treats each region as a replicate and meta-analyses them (directly analogous to per-site analysis); heterogeneity quantified; replication

title: Infant age inversely correlates with gut carriage of resistance genes, reflecting modifications in microbial carbohydrate metabolism during early life
data_scale: 4,132 metagenomes, 963 infants, 19 cohorts / 17 studies, 6 countries
main_methods: Re-processing of public metagenomes; resistome profiling; PERMANOVA variance; random-forest age prediction (R2=68%); host inference; LGT
headline_claim: Infant gut resistance-gene load falls with age; 34 ARGs predict age
what_made_it_strong: Global public-data re-analysis with geography map panel; uniform reprocessing; RF regression

title: The interplay between tissue‐resident microbiome and host proteins by integrated multi‐omics during progression of colorectal adenoma to carcinoma
data_scale: 185 tissue samples (adenoma, tumour, para-tumour); two external datasets
main_methods: Deep shotgun metagenomics + proteomics; multi-kingdom profiling; subtypes; marker-based classifiers (AUROC)
headline_claim: 14 microbial + 8 protein markers separate adenoma from tumour (AUROC 0.962; external 0.920 and 0.735)
what_made_it_strong: Multi-kingdom + proteome integration; reports the weaker external AUROC honestly

title: Gut microbiome and metabolome characteristics of patients with cholesterol gallstones suggest the preventive potential of prebiotics
data_scale: 191 samples 16S; 60 matched metagenomes + metabolomes; mouse models
main_methods: 16S, shotgun, LC-MS; biomarker ROC; monocolonisation; SCFA/FOS interventions
headline_claim: Gallstone patients have distinct microbiome/metabolome; biomarkers discriminate; prebiotics prevent stones in mice
what_made_it_strong: Combines diagnostic markers with causal and intervention experiments

title: Temporal response patterns of human gut microbiota to dietary fiber
data_scale: Overweight (n=10) and T2D (n=9) participants; daily sampling 28 days; 433 metagenomes
main_methods: High-frequency sampling; guild-level analysis; time-series and time-delayed multi-omics
headline_claim: Microbes respond to fibre with distinct temporal patterns missed by sparse sampling
what_made_it_strong: Methodological lesson about sampling density; strong time-series visuals

title: Linking dietary fiber to human malady through cumulative profiling of microbiota disturbance
data_scale: 32 dietary fibres; 161 diseases; curated literature-derived microbe-disease and RCT fibre-microbe associations
main_methods: Bio-taxonomic Hierarchy Weighted Aggregation (BHWA) algorithm; disturbance-score (DS); networks; mouse IBD validation of arabinoxylan
tool_or_resource_released: Yes: mDiFiBank website + Code Ocean capsule
headline_claim: Microbiota-disturbance similarity links fibres to 161 diseases and classifies fibres into 6 functional groups
what_made_it_strong: Huge breadth (161 diseases); new algorithm; wet-lab validation of one prediction; web resource

title: Transmission of antimicrobial resistance genes from the environment to human gut is more pronounced in colorectal cancer patients than in healthy subjects
data_scale: 1,605 stool metagenomes (748 CRC, 857 healthy) + 1,035 city-matched environmental samples (278 newly collected)
main_methods: Resistome profiling; source tracking; core/mobile ARG analysis; HGT efficiency; host inference; PERMANOVA, Wilcoxon, FDR
headline_claim: Environmental ARG transmission into the gut is stronger in CRC than in healthy people
what_made_it_strong: Large pooled public + new data; clear one-line claim; workflow schematic as Fig 1

title: Distinct microbial and metabolic shifts characterize acute coronary syndrome and recovery
data_scale: 548 participants (175 NCA, 161 sCAD, 212 ACS) + independent 52-patient recovery cohort
main_methods: Shotgun metagenomics; untargeted metabolomics/lipidomics; confounder analysis; mediation; random forest with SHAP; q-values
headline_claim: ACS-specific microbial/metabolic shifts (e.g., 3-HB) revert after recovery; integrated models separate CAD stages
what_made_it_strong: Recovery cohort as internal control; SHAP-explained classifier; explicit numbered limitations

title: Nationwide profiling of vaginal microbiota in Chinese women reveals age‐dependent shifts and predictive biomarkers for reproductive health
data_scale: 6,423 women, 18 Chinese provinces, 33 host factors; 13 external datasets for score validation; longitudinal follow-up
main_methods: PERMANOVA variance partitioning; regression with FDR; GAM / sliding-window age analysis; derived microbiome balance score with external validation and prospective prediction
tool_or_resource_released: Code on GitHub (per v1 benchmark); no web tool
headline_claim: Vaginal microbiome shifts around age 40; host factors explain <2% of variation; balance score predicts incident BV/STI
what_made_it_strong: National-scale reference; turns descriptive atlas into a clinically usable score; explicit 2-sentence limitation

title: Spaceflight redefines ageing‐associated microbiota
data_scale: Inspiration4 crew public multi-site metagenomes/metatranscriptomes (n UNVERIFIED)
main_methods: Metagenomic + metatranscriptomic analysis of ageing-associated taxa/genes across body sites
headline_claim: Spaceflight shifts ageing-associated microbiota while accelerating immune ageing
what_made_it_strong: Novel setting; reuse of public data in a Letter

title: The impact of school heavy metal exposure on children's gut microbiota: The mediating role of environmental microorganisms
data_scale: Classroom dust + children's faeces (school cohorts; n UNVERIFIED from abstract)
main_methods: XGBoost; RLQ and fourth-corner analysis; mediation
headline_claim: Environmental microbes mediate heavy-metal effects on children's gut microbiota
what_made_it_strong: Interpretable ML in a short Letter

title: Microbial keystone taxa and metabolic signatures in centenarians regulate intestinal homeostasis during aging
data_scale: Human ageing cohorts incl. centenarians + mice (n UNVERIFIED in abstract)
main_methods: Co-occurrence networks/keystone taxa; strain administration; metabolite (IAA) mechanism via AHR
headline_claim: Centenarian keystone C. scindens stabilises networks and counters intestinal ageing via IAA-AHR
what_made_it_strong: Moves from network statistics to molecular mechanism

title: Two stable gut microbiome guilds predict liver tumor class and treatment responses
data_scale: New cohort 120 HCC + 76 benign liver tumours (shotgun); CRLM comparison; two external anti-PD-1 HCC cohorts
main_methods: Genome-resolved co-abundance networks; Two-Competing-Guilds (TCG) model (142 genomes); classifiers on guild abundances (AUROC); survival/recurrence models; external validation
headline_claim: Stable guild structure, not taxa, gives transferable HCC biomarkers (AUROC 0.70 HCC vs benign; 0.78 vs CRLM) and predicts recurrence/treatment response
what_made_it_strong: Frames taxon-level irreproducibility as the problem and offers a structural fix; multiple clinical endpoints; external validation

title: Gut microbiota‐mediated immune and metabolic dysregulation in coronary artery disease progression and prognosis
data_scale: Prospective cohort n=319, median 1.85 y follow-up; FMT in ApoE-/- mice
main_methods: Metagenomics + metabolomics; ML for MACE prediction; FMT mouse experiments; LPS-TLR4 mechanism
headline_claim: Gut microbial features improve prospective MACE prediction; CAD microbiota transmits atherosclerosis susceptibility in mice
what_made_it_strong: Prospective outcome + causal mouse arm packed into a Letter

title: A gut microbiome‐lipid axis in early pregnancy is associated with metabolic dysregulation and diabetes risk
data_scale: 784 pregnant women (222 later GDM), first trimester; replication vs external T2D meta-analysis (8,117)
main_methods: Nested case-control; metagenomics + lipidomics; cross-omics mediation; external concordance check
headline_claim: Early-pregnancy gut species and lipids precede GDM; 7 species concordant with external T2D populations
what_made_it_strong: Prospective timing; external concordance across disease populations

title: A decade‐scale audit of microbiome AI‐readiness
data_scale: 23,781 papers screened; 2,896 studies; ~720,000 samples; >50 countries
main_methods: PRISMA-guided systematic review; 4-tier BHAM metadata scoring; logistic/multinomial regression over time; bootstrap CI
tool_or_resource_released: Yes: standalone tier-checking tool + curated data (GitHub samd1993/MMC)
headline_claim: Only 5.9% of human microbiome studies share per-sample disease/age/sex; 85.5% of samples are not reusable for cross-cohort AI
what_made_it_strong: One striking number; policy-level call to action; reusable checker tool for editors/reviewers; tight 2-figure Letter

title: Integrative host–microbiome modeling uncovers the implication of oral–gut translocation in advanced cirrhosis
data_scale: Public GLA and RIFSYS cirrhosis cohorts + healthy cohort; TIPS validation cohort
main_methods: Paired oral-gut metagenomics; genome-scale metabolic modelling (reactobiome, community FBA)
headline_claim: Oral-gut translocation in cirrhosis predicted to raise ammonia/acetate production
what_made_it_strong: Re-uses public cohorts to make a new mechanistic claim in Letter format

title: MASS cohort: Multicenter, longitudinal, and prospective study of the role of microbiome in severe pneumonia and host susceptibility
data_scale: 2,000 ICU severe-pneumonia patients planned; 19 hospitals, 10 cities, 3 provinces
main_methods: Multicentre prospective cohort design; BALF, sputum, faeces, blood; metagenomics + transcriptomics
headline_claim: Establishes MASS cohort for lung/gut microbiome in severe pneumonia
what_made_it_strong: Map of centres; clear design figure; resource framing

title: A multi‐centered prospective birth cohort study in Western China
data_scale: 15,093 pregnant women, 8 centres, 5 provinces (altitude/ethnic diversity)
main_methods: Prospective birth cohort; multi-omics biobank
headline_claim: Western China Birth Cohort as platform for gene-environment research
what_made_it_strong: Geographic diversity explicitly the selling point

title: BIOME cohort: Multi‐system microbiome dynamics and clinical outcomes in massive burn injury patients
data_scale: Planned >=150 burn patients, 50 hospitals, 28 provinces
main_methods: Multicentre longitudinal cohort; skin/gut/oral microbiome
headline_claim: BIOME cohort design for burn-injury microbiome
what_made_it_strong: National network map; resource framing

main_methods: Web platform for meta-omics
headline_claim: User-friendly platform for meta-omics analysis

data_scale: NA

data_scale: >1,000 activated-sludge samples (1,186) from 269 WWTPs, 23 countries

data_scale: Platform (41 workflows, 126 visualisation tools)

headline_claim: AI-enabled standardised multi-omics analysis platform
what_made_it_strong: Version update with quantified expansion

data_scale: 1,242 ICB-treated patients across multiple cohorts; in-house cohort; CRISPR screens (17 datasets)
main_methods: ML + genetic algorithm on gene-pair scores (batch-robust IRGPs); validation in independent cohorts; wet-lab CEP55

data_scale: Multiple cell types and chromatin-interaction platforms

data_scale: TCGA (Western) vs CPGEA (Chinese) prostate cancer cohorts
